featured_event.label: Featured Event
featured_event.includes: A labelled FEATURED placement for one event, shown only after review. $299 per event. Logo, banner, and analytics are not included yet.

featured_exhibitor.label: Featured Exhibitor
featured_exhibitor.includes: A labelled FEATURED exhibitor placement for one event, shown only after review. $399 per event. The exhibitor card with logo and booth number is not included yet.

verified_manufacturer.label: Verified Manufacturer
verified_manufacturer.includes: Identity and contact details checked. Not a product certification. Covers 12 months. Single payment, no auto-renewal. The VERIFIED MANUFACTURER badge appears only after review.

job_featured.label: Feature a job
job_featured.includes: One featured job post for 30 days. $299.

rfq_lead_pro.label: Extra lead for Supplier Pro
rfq_lead_pro.includes: One extra lead for Supplier Pro. $149.

learning.label: Learning
learning.includes: 26-chapter design course, tutorial and academy, 10 interactive 3D models, the live design calculator, and the Design Engineer Track. 1 seat. Single payment for 12 months. No auto-renewal.

engineering_pro.label: Engineering Pro
engineering_pro.includes: Everything in Learning, plus BOM and active-material costing, PDF engineering reports, rating-plate drafting, factory test-report drafting, and the country design adapter. 1 seat. Single payment for 12 months. No auto-renewal. Saved designs and the project workspace are not included yet.

engineering_team.label: Engineering Team
engineering_team.includes: Everything in Engineering Pro. Single payment for 12 months. No auto-renewal. Shared team seats are not included yet.

featured_listing.label: Featured Listing
featured_listing.includes: A labelled Featured slot on the directory and country pages for 12 months, plus tax. Set up after the Stripe checkout is confirmed. Featured is a paid placement, not a recommendation.

featured_verified.label: Featured + Verified
featured_verified.includes: The Featured directory slot plus the reviewed Verified Manufacturer badge, for 12 months, plus tax. Neither label is published before review.

component_sponsor.label: Component Sponsor
component_sponsor.includes: One sponsor section on pressboard, core steel, copper, or bushings, billed monthly, plus tax. The section stays empty until a sponsor is reviewed.

commissioning_job_post.label: Commissioning job post
commissioning_job_post.includes: One HV or MV commissioning vacancy. $199. Sending the form does not publish it. The row is added only after review and drops off 30 days after that review.

buyer_guide_us_eu.label: US–EU buyer guide
buyer_guide_us_eu.includes: The US–EU grid-equipment reading as a PDF for a procurement folder: the order section by section, the revoked 2020 order, the request for information, the EU texts, and the same limits on what was not confirmed. $19. Payment does not change the web page.
